Columbus in chains. " Bobadilla, having been sent by Ferdinand and Isabella to Hispaniola, to inquire into the conduct of Columbus, seized upon his property, and ordered him to be thrown into irons, but as no armourer or smith could be found willing to lend himself to so disgraceful a proceeding, it was feared that this order could not be accomplished, until his own cook DUVALL, volunteered to rivet them upon him. Queen Blanche, touched with compassion for them, sent to request their liberation. Instead of complying with her humane desire, the chapter arrested also their wives and families, and crowded them into cells together.
